text.p: National TechTeam Inc said Friday it has completed a public offering of three million shares of the company's common stock at $25.75 per share.
All of the shares were newly issued and sold on behalf of the company, which provides third-party computer support services, including call centers, to software firms and other customers.

The net proceeds of the offering, estimated at about $72 million, will be used for general corporate purposes, including domestic and international call center expansion, capital expenditures, working capital and acquisitions, National TechTeam said.

In conjunction with the offering, the company and certain shareholders have granted to the underwriters an option, exercisable within 30 days, to purchase up to 450,000 additional shares of common stock at the offering price less the aggregate underwriting discounts and commissions, to cover any over-allotments.
Salomon Brothers Inc and Robert W. Baird & Co Inc acted as underwriters of the offering, National TechTeam said.
